step: ADR-015 remediation step 4 — R-7 … R-10 Model B tenant-content RLS infrastructure (migration 0027, the seventh claim, the table-class registry)
usage: source the DATABASE_* environment of a test template database at migration 0024 or later (acc_r015_base), then: node scripts/mutation/run.mjs scripts/mutation/catalogue/step4-r7.json --out <dir>. Every DB command first applies the (mutated) migrations to its disposable clone.

argv: npm run db:migrate --workspace @acc/db && cd packages/db && npx jest --selectProjects integration --runInBand --testPathPatterns "content-rls|table-classes|backstop-definitions|principals|tenant-context-trust"
npm run db:migrate --workspace @acc/db && cd apps/api && npx jest --selectProjects security --runInBand --testPathPatterns content-context
